decisive_failure: value: Even taking correctness and narrow novelty as given, the result is not independently worth finding later. It combines four reject categories the brief explicitly warns against. (1) Textbook restatement: the scientifically meaningful pattern (Z8 transversal-free; all other listed groups transversal-rich) is a direct corollary of Hall-Paige (1955 conjecture, proved 2009 via CFSG), acknowledged in DRAFT sec 4.3 as sanity check; isotopy invariance of tau/N is elementary one-paragraph proof; collapse via Albert's theorem is textbook. (2) Mere parameter substitution: strata are 30 seeded row/col/symbol permutations with arbitrary seed 5757+k plus base (186 squares); by construction every isotope is isotopic to its base, so 186->6 collapse is tautological (DRAFT sec 2.2/6 admits no isotope can beat baseline, theoretically impossible). The seed count, seed value, and choice of orders 7-8 add no conceptual stratification. (3) Tiny unmotivated gain / unexplained enumeration: the only potentially new numbers are N=133 and N=384 (x4), obtained in seconds by brute force for n<=8 (40320 perms max, ~3k DFS nodes), with no structural explanation — DRAFT sec 6.3 admits N=384 coincidence across four non-isomorphic groups is verified computation, not theorem, left open. No new infinite family (disclaimed), no surprising distribution (no beating isotope, impossible), no downstream use. (4) Scope disclaimer empties significance: DRAFT sec 6.1 stresses this is not a full order-7/8 census (which numbers in millions/billions per main class) but six group tables only. A seconds-scale table of six small-group transversal counts with redundant isotopic copies and no theory is a routine exercise, not a citable micro-census others would independently seek. Correct and narrowly new yet not valuable => REJECT per value-failure rule.

method_summary: exact-cover branch-and-bound transversal search with isotopy-class reduction and CSV-based property replay
problem_statement: Let G7={Z7} and G8={Z8, C4xC2, C2^3, D8, Q8} with normalized Cayley tables on symbols 0..n-1. For each base B generate 30 seeded isotopes by independent uniform row, column and symbol permutations (seed 5757+index) plus B itself (<=186 squares for n=7,8 combined). Deduplicate to isotopy-class representatives R by exhaustive pairwise isotopy backtracking (n<=8, logged). For each S in R compute transversal number tau(S) and full-transversal count N(S) by DLX exact-cover branch-and-bound with node-count logs. Tabulate tau/N per stratum, exhibit one explicit stratum-maximum square with full transversal cell list (r,c,s) and, for each transversal-free S found, a maximal partial-transversal witness with exhaustive unsatisfiability log. Deliver squares.csv, transversals.csv, partial.csv and verifier.py replaying Latin property and disjointness from CSVs alone.
